children: Rent the Runway, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $97.7M, a 20.8% increase from $80.9M a year earlier, and a net loss of ($12.9M) versus ($26.4M) in the prior-year quarter; diluted loss per share improved to ($0.38) from ($6.23).
¹ Reported as “Total revenue, net”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “loss per share attributable to common stockholders, basic and diluted”.
Revenue growth was driven by higher revenue per subscriber and increased subscription pricing; YTD growth noted at 24.7%.
Channel mix shifted toward more capital-efficient sourcing: about 69% of new items in FY25 came via Share by RTR and Exclusive Designs, reducing upfront inventory purchases.
Brand partnerships for Share by RTR and Exclusive Designs expanded assortment and aimed to improve margins and lower inventory risk.
Operational improvements supported margin gains and better Adjusted EBITDA, helped by lower fulfillment costs as a percent of revenue and operating leverage.
Product and technology initiatives included AI outfit generation, avatar launches (May–Aug 2026), and a virtual try-on pilot to boost engagement and conversions.
